Not a theory. A finding.

Every finding carries the question, both queries, the divergence, and the fix. The verified query is handed over to be read, not trusted.

the mechanism: a pair of queries differing in exactly one place, and a contract that the trap must run without error. a loud failure measures nothing.

The record

Verified hallucinations, on the record.

Not anecdotes: cases with a court file, a tribunal ruling, or a refund attached. Not all of them are language models, and the oldest is an ordinary accounting system. That is the point: fluent, well-formatted, wrong.

1999 An accounting system reported branch shortfalls that did not exist. Over 1,000 people prosecuted; the inquiry links at least 13 deaths, while declining to claim causation for all of them. Horizon Inquiry ↗
2023 Lawyers filed a federal brief citing six court cases that do not exist, complete with quotes and docket numbers. Sanctioned $5,000. Mata v. Avianca ↗
2024 Air Canada's chatbot invented a bereavement refund policy. The tribunal held the airline liable for what its bot said. Moffatt v. Air Canada ↗
2025 A government report by a Big Four firm cited research that does not exist. Found by an outside academic, not by the firm that wrote it. Part of the fee refunded. Deloitte refund ↗
2025 The same model answers 91.2% correctly on the curated benchmark and 21.3% on real warehouses. Nothing marks the failures as failures. Spider 2.0, ICLR ↗
2026 A warehouse assistant reported 95 customers instead of 621: wrong cohort anchor, valid SQL, no error. Found in our own suite, reproducible in the repository. Finding F-07 →

the public cases got caught because they were spectacular. the warehouse kind is quieter, and that is the whole problem.

Before you call anyone · open source

Test it yourself first. quaesitor-zero asks your assistant twenty questions your schema cannot answer, and scores whether it admits that.

  1. You need uv, and nothing else. uvx runs the tool without installing it; pip install quaesitor-zero works too.
  2. Export your schema. It is the CREATE TABLE statements your warehouse already produces, no rows.schema.sql
  3. uvx quaesitor-zero generate --schema schema.sql --include-ambiguous --out questions.csv20 questions, half of them with no answer in your data, each with the reason it has none. Nothing calls a model: they are composed from the schema and seeded from its digest, so the same schema always gives the same set.What was our inventory turnover in 1999? What was the total quantity in Q3 2003? What was our refund rate in 1999?...
  4. Ask your own assistant each one and paste what it said into the response column.id,question,response
  5. uvx quaesitor-zero score --answers questions.csv --out scorecard.htmlThe same file, now filled in.
  6. Open scorecard.html. On the shipped TPC-DS example, against Claude Sonnet 5:silent overreach 3/10answered 11 of 20, coverage 55%
no network code. no telemetry. no model access. Apache-2.0.

One wrong number is already in a deck somewhere.

Reading

Published measurements, and the argument behind them.

  • Documentation made the errors smaller, not rarer a measurement, with the test stated and the p-values it actually earns
  • Silent-failure rate: two models, opposite failure behaviour identical correct counts, and nothing alike about how they fail
  • What it does when it does not know the longer piece on abstention
  • Trust grows faster than accuracy why this exists
